name: Uxbridge Shopping Center
summary: Uxbridge Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail plaza on North Main Street in Uxbridge, MA, anchored by Uxbridge Liquors. With convenient hours from 7 AM to 10 PM and a strong 4.2-star rating, it serves as a reliable shopping destination for the local Blackstone Valley community.
demographics: Uxbridge Shopping Center primarily serves middle-income families and working professionals in the Blackstone Valley region of Massachusetts. The trade area draws from Uxbridge and surrounding Worcester County communities, with a customer base that includes both local residents seeking convenience shopping and commuters along Route 146. Typical visitors are value-conscious shoppers aged 25-65 with household incomes in the $60,000-$90,000 range, seeking everyday necessities and specialty items like liquor and convenience goods in a practical, accessible location.
description: Uxbridge Shopping Center is a convenient neighborhood retail destination located at 158 North Main Street in the historic town of Uxbridge, Massachusetts. Serving the Blackstone Valley community since its establishment, this shopping center has become a reliable stop for local residents seeking everyday essentials and specialty items. The center is anchored by Uxbridge Liquors, a well-established liquor store that has built a strong reputation in the community, offering an extensive selection of wines, spirits, and craft beers. With operating hours from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM, the center provides extended accessibility for busy shoppers and commuters traveling along the Route 146 corridor. The shopping center maintains a solid 4.2-star rating from over 630 Google reviews, reflecting its consistent service and value to the local community. Its location on North Main Street places it in a high-visibility area with easy access for both Uxbridge residents and visitors from neighboring towns in Worcester County.
